title: Compare to Correct: Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment for LLM Test-Time Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2610.18583v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sampling-based test-time scaling enhances LLM reasoning by aggregating multiple reasoning paths for the same query. Existing methods use answer frequencies or path confidence to compute candidate scores, which do not explicitly characterize comparisons between competing answers. Inspired by the Condorcet principle in social choice theory, we introduce pairwise confidence comparisons between paths supporting different answers to capture answer-level comparative advantage. We combine this comparative evidence with voting support through a KL-regularized objective. Theoretically, we show that this comparative-advantage is equivalent to the adjustment to the traditional voting logits. In this way, our proposed Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment (PGLA) framework allows comparative evidence to compensate for weaker voting support and correct voting-based ranking errors. translated_title: 比较以纠正：面向大语言模型测试时扩展的成对引导Logit调整
translated_abstract: 基于采样的测试时扩展通过聚合同一查询的多条推理路径来增强大语言模型的推理能力。现有方法使用答案频率或路径置信度来计算候选分数，未能显式刻画相互竞争的答案之间的比较关系。受社会选择理论中孔多塞原则的启发，我们引入了支持不同答案的路径之间的成对置信度比较，以捕捉答案层面的比较优势。我们通过一个KL正则化目标将这种比较证据与投票支持相结合。在理论上，我们证明了这种比较优势等价于对传统投票logits的调整。通过这种方式，我们提出的成对引导Logit调整（PGLA）框架能够利用比较证据弥补较弱的投票支持，并纠正基于投票的排序错误。在包括数学推理、k（后文截断）等10个具有挑战性的基准上的实验……
tldr: 该论文提出成对引导Logit调整（PGLA）框架，受孔多塞原则启发，通过路径间的成对置信度比较捕捉答案层面的比较优势，从而弥补投票支持的不足并纠正大语言模型测试时扩展中的投票排序错误。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Pairwise-Guided Logit Adjustment (PGLA), a Condorcet-principle-inspired framework that leverages pairwise confidence comparisons between reasoning paths to capture answer-level comparative advantage, compensating for weak voting support and correcting voting-based ranking errors in LLM test-time scaling.
